title: The Price of Intelligence: A Quality-Adjusted Price Index for AI Services
abstract: arXiv:2608.29843v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Posted prices for AI inference have fallen steadily since 2024, yet the measured speed of that fall depends almost entirely on the method of measurement. This paper constructs quality-adjusted price indices for the AI inference market from public data. The panel assembles 21,024 posted-price observations across 3,208 models and 86 providers and joins them to 4,605 benchmark scores through a latent quality index estimated from benchmark response patterns, so the quality ladder of the hedonic tradition is built here from evaluations in place of product characteristics. Measured by the matched-model methods that statistical agencies apply to software, inference prices fell at 0.10 log points a year. The quality-adjusted index fell at 0.73, so 87% of the decline is invisible to current methods, with direct consequences for measured competition, concentration and productivity in this market. translated_title: 智能的价格：AI服务质量调整价格指数
translated_abstract: 自2024年以来，AI推理服务的标价持续稳步下降，但测得的下降速度几乎完全取决于测量方法。本文基于公开数据构建了AI推理市场的质量调整价格指数。该面板数据集汇集了来自3,208个模型和86家提供商的21,024个标价观测值，并通过从基准测试响应模式中估计出的潜在质量指数，将这些数据与4,605个基准测试分数相连接——因此，享乐价格传统中的质量阶梯在此由评估结果而非产品特征构建而成。按照统计机构应用于软件的匹配模型方法测量，推理价格每年下降0.10个对数点；而质量调整指数每年下降0.73个对数点，这意味着87%的降幅在现有方法下是不可见的，并对该市场的竞争、集中度和生产率的测量产生直接影响。此外，按完成任务数量计算，买方的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文构建了AI推理市场的质量调整价格指数，发现推理价格经质量调整后实际每年下降0.73个对数点，是传统匹配模型方法测得降幅的七倍多，意味着87%的价格下降被现有统计方法所遗漏。
